facts.title: regulator directive concerning energy isolation at PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in mustering and rescuing, specifically deploying an emergency response team. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during routine operation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 19 February 2019 a regulatory notice was issued concerning PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following routine operation.
